name: LibraryApp sources
description: The Library app (photo catalog): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/LibraryApp, built from SuiteUI: the window with its thumbnail grid, the loupe (one photo on CanvasViewport at its own pixel size, its render or a placeholder, with its position readout, arrow keys and Escape), the metadata inspector for the selected photos (rating, flag, color label), and the File > Load Sample Photos, View > Grid and Loupe, View > Sort By and thumbnail size commands.
